name: mirage
text: Found it. When the game finished, the app marked those 2 bets won, but Novig hadn't paid them out yet. The tracker then took Novig's money so far (only what you paid in) as the result, so two wins showed as -$2.00. Fixed in code and tested: a won bet whose payout hasn't arrived now shows its expected profit until Novig's settlement lands. It's not in a release yet. It also affects the Tracker, not only the NCAAB card; I'll ship it with the next batch.
